categories.main_business_segments: Changzhou Fusion New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of new electronic pastes, primarily photovoltaic conductive pastes used in solar cells. The company also develops electronic materials for semiconductor, display, lighting, and energy storage applications, including conductive adhesives and semiconductor materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced materials science and manufacturing technologies, including proprietary formulations of silver, silver-coated copper, and copper powders for conductive pastes. It employs cutting-edge printing and sintering techniques such as LECO laser-enhanced contact, ultra-narrow line printing, and low-temperature curing for perovskite tandem cells. The firm also integrates a full-stack R&D system covering materials, processes, and equipment, with significant investments in powder metallurgy and nano-material surface treatments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading solar cell manufacturers including Tongwei Solar, Trina Solar, Jinko Solar, JA Solar, and others. The company serves the photovoltaic industry primarily, with expanding presence in electronic components for automotive electronics, 5G communication devices, and consumer electronics. Its products are critical in the upstream solar cell metallization process and electronic component manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and production bases in Shanghai, Yibin, Japan, Thailand, Singapore, and other locations to serve global markets. Its overseas footprint includes production facilities in Thailand and sales channels across emerging markets such as the Middle East, India, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fusion New Material operates upstream in the photovoltaic supply chain, producing key raw materials and conductive pastes essential for solar cell metallization. It is extending upstream into metal powder production and downstream into electronic adhesives and functional materials, aiming for vertical integration and comprehensive metallization solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to innovate in low-silver and silver-free conductive pastes, ultra-fine line printing, and new cell technologies like TOPCon, HJT, and perovskite tandem cells. It is developing proprietary metal powders and expanding into electronic functional materials for automotive and 5G applications. Strategic initiatives include building high-end photovoltaic electronic material bases and dedicated R&D centers to enhance product performance and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and distribution of photovoltaic conductive pastes and electronic materials to solar cell manufacturers and electronic component producers. The company also earns income from licensing proprietary technologies and providing technical support services. Financial instruments and investment income contribute marginally to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Fusion New Material is a global leader in photovoltaic conductive pastes, holding a top position in shipment volume and technological innovation. It competes with international and domestic suppliers of silver pastes and emerging copper paste providers. The company has broken foreign monopolies in high-end electronic pastes and maintains strong partnerships with major solar cell manufacturers, reinforcing its competitive moat.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 12.49 billion, a 21.35% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 418 million. Despite a slight profit decline, adjusted net profit excluding non-recurring items grew by 2.52%. The firm maintains robust R&D spending at 6.74% of revenue and continues expanding production capacity and market share, reflecting a strong growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fusion New Material offers high-performance, technologically advanced conductive pastes tailored for next-generation photovoltaic cells, enabling higher conversion efficiencies and lower production costs. Its unique value lies in proprietary low-silver and silver-free paste technologies, comprehensive metallization solutions, and integrated upstream powder production. The company emphasizes product reliability, rapid innovation cycles, and customized technical support to enhance customer competitiveness and foster long-term partnerships.
